status_description: V1 and V0 ablation/silencing simulations executed with author geometry, connectivity masks, and integration routines. Under released network parameters, V1 ablation abolishes active rhythmic bursting (amplitude drops to ~2.0 a.u. quiescent state rather than published ~22 a.u. slow bursting). V0 ablation preserves robust bursting (~45 a.u.) but does not complete the full transition to bilateral in-phase synchrony (~0 rad) without compensatory drive adjustments.
